digest.component_or_area: ADR documentation and architectural decision framework
propositions: ADR 0098 must document the approved decision that Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration with separately owned provider-auth/runtime bindings at application boundaries
The ADR must cite completed primary-source research for Pydantic, PydanticAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, Git credential helpers, Jira integrations, and CI secret injection behavior

ADR 0098 records operation snapshot precedence, lifecycle, composition ownership, subsystem projections, provider-native pre-client auth injection, static carrier types, subprocess environment rules, and restart/redeploy static rotation without hot reload

The ADR clarifies op-cert startup composition requires exactly one path or multiline value, validates before service work, uses process-owned 0700/0600 copy, and preserves ADR 0049 algorithm/trust-root/producer/storage choices
ADR 0098 must preserve unaffected decisions in ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0049, 0050, 0059, and 0083 while narrowing ADR 0049 only at per-job retrieval/composition seam

Generated documentation artifacts `.numbers/0098` and `docs/adr/README.md` must pass validation; Draft Critique must identify all uncited claims, inconsistencies, and ADR conflicts before maintainer approval
